facts.text: The doctor’s surgery in Newtown is considering moving appointment details from a spreadsheet-based system to a relational database.
The doctor’s surgery looks after the health of the town’s residents.
Residents can book an appointment to meet with their registered doctor.
The surgery maintains a spreadsheet containing each patient’s name, address, date of birth, and phone number.
The spreadsheet stores each patient’s most recent diagnosed condition.
The spreadsheet stores each patient’s current medication due to their recent condition.
The spreadsheet stores each patient’s known allergies.
Each doctor can be registered to more than one patient.
Each patient can have more than one registered doctor.
A patient can be seen by a doctor that they are not registered with.
The ‘Known allergies’ and ‘Current Medication’ columns are empty unless populated by the doctor.
An appointment cannot exist without a patient or a doctor.
The user wants a query to count how many patients have Dr Jenkins as one of their registered doctors.
The user wants a query to calculate the average age of all patients.
The user wants a query to return all patients whose last name is ‘Jones’.
The user wants a query to find the names of patients born before 1st January 1980.
The user wants a query to list all patients’ names along with their registered doctors’ names.
The user wants a query to list all patients who are currently taking medication, including patient name, current medication, and the recent condition the medication is for.

The user wants a query to list all patients with their name and date of birth, and to return the medication if the patient has had a recent condition, otherwise return null in the current medication field.

events.text: Move appointment details from spreadsheet to relational database (design task).
Decompose design to create schema in 2NF or 3NF with tables, keys, and diagram.

Write multiple SQL queries: patient names, distinct addresses, count for Dr Jenkins, average age, Jones last name, born before 1 January 1980, patient names with registered doctors, currently taking medication, and medication/null logic.
